Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20, Planning Commission Members will be participating via
teleconference.

- Commission meeting videos are live-streamed on the City’s website at www.rhe.city/agendas and available for
viewing thereafter. Commission meetings are recorded for minutes preparation purposes.

- Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone, Meeting ID:
897 5551 4665 Passcode: 570020. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the call-in option from
a phone line.)

-  Public  correspondence  may  be  emailed  to  Carol Corea, Administrative  Assistant  at
carolc@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails received before 5:00 p.m. the night of the meeting will be forwarded to
the Commission for their consideration and included as part of the record.

- Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos”
page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/agendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an “eComment”
button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp page. After
you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen by the
public, will be considered by the Commission and become part of the record.

- Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting, may join by visiting http://www.zoom.com/join
and enter the following credentials: Meeting ID: 897 5551 4665 Passcode: 570020.

- If using a tablet or phone, download the Zoom app and enter the following credentials: Meeting ID: 897 5551
4665 Passcode: 570020.

Members of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the
following process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at
the lower portion of your screen. The host will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you
would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each agenda item are available on the City's
website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city/agendas.

MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, JUNE 7, 2021

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order by CHAIR EDLER at 7:00 p.m. Pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20, this
  meeting was held via teleconference.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR EDLER led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Edler, Scott, *Carman, Medawar, Schachter, Yoo, Zigrang

  City Staff Present:  David Wahba, Director of Community Development and Public Works
  Jeannie Naughton, Planning Manager
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

  * Joined the meeting at 7:15 p.m.

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES - MAY 3, 2021

  B.  APPROVAL OF SPECIAL PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES - MAY 24, 2021

  VICE CHAIR SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACTHER to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF MAY 3, 2021 AND
  MAY 24, 2021

  There being no objection, CHAIR EDLER so ordered.

  5.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  NONE

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  2021 BIANNUAL CODE COMPLIANCE REPORT

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked about a specific complaint on trash cans that were left out.
  Code Compliance Officer Hall stated that the complaint came from a resident who lives on this
  particular street; a letter is sent to the resident reminding them that trash cans cannot be left out for
  prolonged periods of time.

  COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR inquired on the status of 2 Silver Saddle. Code Compliance Officer
  Hall stated that the plans have been submitted and they are being reviewed.

  VICE CHAIR SCOTT inquired on the status of 9 Lantana. Director Wahba stated that there the
  property owner is waiting for clearances from Environmental and the Fire Department.

  COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR inquired on the status of 31 Santa Bella. Director Wahba stated that
  he did not have the status on this property, but would look into it.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-210169; ADDRESS: 27063 PALOS VERDES DRIVE
  EAST; APPLICANT: CHRIS BENNETT, CHADMAR/COLFIN ROLLING HILLS, LLC; A
  request for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination (NC-210170) for a new two-story
  residence.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that staff received correspondence from several neighbors
  regarding a variety of impacts that were subsequently assessed through site visits. Based on the
  site visits, staff is recommending changes to the project and the applicant was amenable to making
  those changes.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that staff recommends no discussion on this item and that the
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
MINUTES, JUNE 7, 2021
  1
   meeting be continued to the July 6, 2021 meeting.

  VICE CHAIR SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,
  CONTINUE ITEM 6-A TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF JULY 6, 2021.

  There being no objection, CHAIR EDLER so ordered.

  B.  DRAFT ACCESSORY DWELLING UNIT (ADU) PROGRAM (VERBAL REPORT)

  Planning Manager Naughton provided an update on the Accessory Dwelling Unit Program. Staff is
  developing a website for this program, which will include, what, why, how, and resources pertaining
  to the ADU program. Planning Manager provided an overview of the items which will be included in
  each section. Four different plan types will be provided, from a studio to a two-bedroom unit.
  Planning Manager Naughton stated that the plans are being prepared and this should be ready to
  roll-out by mid to late August 2021.

  VICE CHAIR SCOTT asked about the horse overlay zone since having an ADU on a horse property
  would violate the City’s 35 ft. setback requirement. Planning Manager Naughton stated that the City
  cannot preclude the construction of an ADU on a horse property based on the 35 ft. spacing to
  equestrian facilities. Planning Manager Naughton stated that the way the ordinance has been
  structured and how it will be presented to the community, is that staff will work with applicants to try
  to provide the 35 ft. spacing, but it cannot be a requirement. Director Wahba stated that the 35 ft.
  spacing will be a guideline that staff will try to preserve as much as possible.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN inquired about applicant’s proposing to build an ADU on top of a barn.
  Planning Manager Naughton stated that the City’s zoning code does not allow two-story accessory
  structures. However, a barn can be converted to an ADU.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN inquired about barns with attached ADUs. Planning Manager
  Naughton stated that such a proposal would be discouraged.

  C.  METAL STANDING SEAM ROOF CRITERIA (VERBAL REPORT)

  Planning Manager Naughton presented a copy of the City’s current reroof application and how it can
  be revised to include standing seam roof as a material type. Staff is proposing to also require photos
  for architectural compatibility.

  Planning Manager Naughton also presented the current list of approved roof brands and asked if
  the Planning Commission would like something similar for standing seam roof materials. The form
  would be renamed to, “Approved Roof Materials”. Planning Manager Naughton stated that staff can
  pull information to use from the Cool Roof Rating Council (CRRC) website and create a list of
  acceptable standing seam roof brands.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that the alternate would be to provide very detailed architectural
  guidelines. Staff would review applications at an administrative level; however, there would be an
  option to appeal to the Planning Commission.

  VICE CHAIR SCOTT stated that there should not be detailed architectural guidelines. He stated that
  he is in favor of amending the approved roofing materials list to include standing seam roofs along
  with the URL to the CRRC website for cool roof options.

  In response to a question by VICE CHAIR SCOTT, Planning Manager Naughton confirmed that the
  Approved Roof Brands list is not an exclusive list, it is a pre-approved list.

  Director Wahba added that reds, blues, and green standing seam roofs should be discouraged and
  promote earth tones including charcoal grays.

  A brief discussion ensued on how to determine acceptable colors.

  Planning Manager Naughton added that colors will be limited to what meets Title 24 Building Code
  and CRRC standards.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that staff could put together a list and bring it back to the
  Planning Commission.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN stated that in looking at the colors that would meet the building code,
  it would limit the blues, but it would allow for reds. She added that having this roof color may be
  shocking if next to a home with the City’s typical architectural style. COMMISSIONER CARMAN
  stated that she agrees with Director Wahba in keeping the acceptable roof colors subtle.

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
MINUTES, JUNE 7, 2021
  2
   CHAIR EDLER expressed his concern with having a list of acceptable roof colors and stated that it
  would be difficult to deny an application for a roof color that does not work aesthetically. Director
  Wahba stated that the application could be revised to state earth tones and exclude the use of blues,
  reds, and greens.

  8.  COMMISSIONER ITEMS

  CHAIR EDLER stated that he would like the City to pay close attention to what is being proposed
  by South Bay HOA in regards to the trees that will be replaced on PVDN in relation to the trees that
  have died.

  9.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  NONE

  10.  MANAGER ITEMS

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that the General Plan Update Scoping Meeting was held on
  June 3rd. The comment period for the Notice of Preparation of the Draft EIR is open until June 21,
  2021. The recording of the meeting along with the Notice of Preparation of the Draft EIR is on the
  City’s website for those who could not attend the meeting and would like to provide comments.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that the Draft Housing Element will be presented to the City
  Council at their meeting tomorrow, June 8, 2021 and assuming that all goes well, it will be sent for
  review to HCD this week.

  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS - MAY 11, 2021

  B.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES DRAFT MEETING MINUTES - MAY 17, 2021

  VICE CHAIR SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE ITEMS 11A AND 11B

  There being no objection, CHAIR EDLER so ordered.

  12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR EDLER adjourned the meeting at 7:52 p.m.

  The next Adjourned Planning Commission meeting will be held on Tuesday, July 6, 2021 at 7:00
  p.m.

  Respectfully submitted by,  Approved,

  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Rick Edler, Chair
